div.div: Grouping by producing context (ADR-0040). One consumer per event-producing bounded context, with strategy dispatch — not one Lambda per event, nor a switch inside the handler. Each producer gets its own strategy interface; never shared.

Each producer gets its own strategy interface; never shared.
